answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the dune check immediately, the zenith audit keeps the resolved set and the tide replay publishes exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Copying the same citations across 107 aliases therefore pays the reading cost 107 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
